mapper.select: WITH scoped_admissions AS ( SELECT a.* FROM admission a WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('IN_HOSPITAL','PENDING_DISCHARGE') THEN 1 END) current_inpatients, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status='PENDING_DISCHARGE' THEN 1 END) pending_discharge_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('IN_HOSPITAL','PENDING_DISCHARGE') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,a.admission_time,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= #{longStayDays} THEN 1 END) long_stay_count, #{longStayDays} long_stay_days, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed b JOIN room r ON r.id=b.room_id JOIN ward w ON w.id=r.ward_id JOIN department d ON d.id=w.department_id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND w.active=TRUE AND d.active=TRUE AND b.status='AVAILABLE' AND d.id=#{scopeDepartment}) available_beds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed b JOIN room r ON r.id=b.room_id JOIN ward w ON w.id=r.ward_id JOIN department d ON d.id=w.department_id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND w.active=TRUE AND d.active=TRUE AND b.status='OCCUPIED' AND d.id=#{scopeDepartment}) occupied_beds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bed b JOIN room r ON r.id=b.room_id JOIN ward w ON w.id=r.ward_id JOIN department d ON d.id=w.department_id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND w.active=TRUE AND d.active=TRUE AND b.status='MAINTENANCE' AND d.id=#{scopeDepartment}) maintenance_beds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_overdue_accounts voa JOIN scoped_admissions sa ON sa.id=voa.admission_id) overdue_patient_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-voa.available_balance),0) FROM v_overdue_accounts voa JOIN scoped_admissions sa ON sa.id=voa.admission_id) overdue_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status='PENDING_DISCHARGE' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM medical_order mo WHERE mo.admission_id=a.id AND mo.status IN ('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','IN_PROGRESS')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v_admission_deposit_balance db WHERE db.admission_id=a.id AND db.available_balance<0) ) THEN 1 END) blocked_discharge_count FROM scoped_admissions a

WITH RECURSIVE scoped_admissions AS ( SELECT a.* FROM admission a WHERE 1=1 ), dates AS ( SELECT CAST(#{from} AS DATE) stat_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(stat_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM dates WHERE stat_date < #{to} ) SELECT dates.stat_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_admissions a WHERE a.status<>'CANCELLED' AND a.admission_time >= dates.stat_date AND a.admission_time < DATE_ADD(dates.stat_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY)) admitted_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_admissions a WHERE a.status='DISCHARGED' AND a.discharge_time >= dates.stat_date AND a.discharge_time < DATE_ADD(dates.stat_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY)) discharged_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_admissions a WHERE a.status<>'CANCELLED' AND a.admission_time < DATE_ADD(dates.stat_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (a.discharge_time IS NULL OR a.discharge_time >= DATE_ADD(dates.stat_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY))) inpatient_census FROM dates ORDER BY dates.stat_date

WITH scoped_admissions AS ( SELECT a.* FROM admission a WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT d.id department_id, d.name department_name, COALESCE(SUM(a.status IN ('IN_HOSPITAL','PENDING_DISCHARGE')),0) current_inpatients, COALESCE(SUM(a.status<>'CANCELLED' AND DATE(a.admission_time) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}),0) admitted_count, COALESCE(SUM(a.status='DISCHARGED' AND DATE(a.discharge_time) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}),0) discharged_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN scoped_admissions a ON a.department_id=d.id d.id=#{scopeDepartment} GROUP BY d.id,d.name ORDER BY d.code

SELECT w.id ward_id, w.name ward_name, d.name department_name, COUNT(b.id) total_beds, SUM(b.status='OCCUPIED') occupied_beds, SUM(b.status='AVAILABLE') available_beds, SUM(b.status='MAINTENANCE') maintenance_beds, SUM(b.status='DISABLED') disabled_beds, ROUND(SUM(b.status='OCCUPIED') / NULLIF(SUM(b.status IN ('OCCUPIED','AVAILABLE')),0) * 100, 2) utilization_rate FROM ward w JOIN department d ON d.id=w.department_id JOIN room r ON r.ward_id=w.id JOIN bed b ON b.room_id=r.id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND w.active=TRUE AND d.active=TRUE AND d.id=#{scopeDepartment} GROUP BY w.id,w.name,d.name ORDER BY d.name,w.name

SELECT d.id department_id, d.name department_name, mi.item_type, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.amount),0),2) revenue FROM department d LEFT JOIN charge_detail c ON c.department_id=d.id AND c.charged_at >= #{from} AND c.charged_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN medical_item mi ON mi.id=c.medical_item_id d.id=#{departmentId} GROUP BY d.id,d.name,mi.item_type ORDER BY d.name,mi.item_type

SELECT mi.id medical_item_id, mi.item_code, mi.name item_name, mi.unit, SUM(CASE WHEN dit.transaction_type IN ('DISPENSE','RETURN') THEN -dit.quantity ELSE 0 END) used_quantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN dit.transaction_type='DISPENSE' THEN ABS(dit.quantity) ELSE 0 END),3) dispensed_quantity FROM drug_inventory_transaction dit JOIN medical_item mi ON mi.id=dit.medical_item_id WHERE DATE(dit.created_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY mi.id,mi.item_code,mi.name,mi.unit ORDER BY used_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH scoped_admissions AS ( SELECT a.* FROM admission a WHERE 1=1 ), completed AS ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,a.admission_time,a.discharge_time)/24 los_days FROM scoped_admissions a WHERE a.status='DISCHARGED' AND a.discharge_time >= #{from} AND a.discharge_time < DATE_ADD(#{to},INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), ranked AS ( SELECT los_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY los_days) rn, COUNT(*) OVER() sample_size FROM completed ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(los_days),2) average_length_of_stay, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn IN (FLOOR((sample_size+1)/2),FLOOR((sample_size+2)/2)) THEN los_days END),2) median_length_of_stay, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(sample_size*0.90) THEN los_days END),2) p90_length_of_stay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_overdue_accounts voa JOIN scoped_admissions sa ON sa.id=voa.admission_id) overdue_patient_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-voa.available_balance),0) FROM v_overdue_accounts voa JOIN scoped_admissions sa ON sa.id=voa.admission_id) overdue_amount, COUNT(*) discharged_sample_size FROM ranked

WITH scoped_admissions AS ( SELECT a.* FROM admission a WHERE 1=1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN los_days <= 3 THEN '0-3天' WHEN los_days <= 7 THEN '4-7天' WHEN los_days <= 14 THEN '8-14天' WHEN los_days <= 30 THEN '15-30天' ELSE '30天以上' END stay_bucket, COUNT(*) patient_count FROM ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR,a.admission_time,a.discharge_time)/24 los_days FROM scoped_admissions a WHERE a.status='DISCHARGED' AND a.discharge_time >= #{from} AND a.discharge_time < DATE_ADD(#{to},INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) completed GROUP BY stay_bucket ORDER BY FIELD(stay_bucket,'0-3天','4-7天','8-14天','15-30天','30天以上')
